international.title: Shabana Mahmood pledges to tackle ‘corrosive and growing perception of two-tier policing’ – UK politics live
international.summary: Home secretary to give speech to National Police Chiefs’ Council addressing concerns that officers treats groups differently In his Today interview, David Lammy also said that he would not be standing to be Labour’s next candidate for mayor of London. He said he was still enjoying national politics. There had been speculation that he might apply if Sadiq Khan decided not to stand for a fourth term in 2028. Today voting ends in the Tory election to choose their candidate and James Cleverly (like Lammy, a former foreign secretary), is expected to win. Khan had been expected not to seek a fourth term. But, with Andy Burnham beefing up the powers available to mayors, making the job more attractive, there is increasing speculation that he will try to stay on. I don’t think that there’s two-tier policing in Britain. But I think there’s a preception [of two-tier policing] because of too many guidelines that are not straightforward. If [Shabana Mahmood] is tidying that up – I haven’t seen the detail [of her speech later] – then I would welcome that. Continue reading...
